## Feature-learning signatures at n = 16384 (Adam)

Fourier order: target characters with |coefficient| >= 0.05, by decreasing |coefficient|, with the first checkpoint step at which the network's coefficient reaches half the target's. PR = participation-ratio rank of the centred layer-1 / layer-2 kernels (init -> final). dW1 = ||W1 - W1(0)||_F / ||W1(0)||_F.
